title: feat(types): the dashboard widget's TypeScript chartConfig refuses the retired `aria`, and both faces are pinned (objectui#4044)
body:
Fixes #4044
Clause-②: yes

The last open key on this card is `chartConfig.aria`. Ruling C (card comment 5642794441) judged the protocol wrong for it. objectstack-ai/objectstack#17751 retired `ChartConfig.aria` as a `retiredKey` tombstone, released in `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0, which the lockfile on `main` has pinned since PR objectui#11086. This PR adds the contract twins' half of that retirement. The nine keys PR objectui#9202 delivered are untouched, and so are `xAxis` / `yAxis` / `series`.

## What changed

- **TypeScript twin (`packages/types/src/complex.ts`).** `DashboardWidgetSchema.chartConfig` was typed `any`, so an authored `aria` compiled. Its `aria` member now comes from the spec by reference: the type is `NonNullable` of `SpecDashboardWidget['chartConfig']`, indexed at `aria`, and it resolves to `undefined`. Authoring a value is a compile error (TS2322). Every other `chartConfig` key keeps its `any` typing through an index signature. That narrow route keeps the two fences above.
- **Zod twin: no code change.** `zod/complex.zod.ts` `DashboardWidgetSchema` takes the spec's `chartConfig` by reference (`specFieldsExcept` excludes only `id` and `type`). It has refused `aria` since the lockfile moved to 17.5.0.
- **Pin (`packages/types/src/__tests__/chartconfig-aria-retired-4044.test.ts`)**, shaped like `dashboard-aria-retired-contract-twins.test.ts`:
  - The TypeScript leg has three type-level assertions and a `@ts-expect-error` on an authored literal. The control is a legal `{ title, description, colors }` literal that still compiles.
  - The Zod twin refuses `aria` at `chartConfig.aria` with code `invalid_type`. The message must equal the spec's own tombstone message, which the test reads from the spec at run time, so no prose is copied into the test. `{ title, description }` still parses (the control).
  - An unknown chart-config key is refused as `unrecognized_keys` on `chartConfig`. That shows the red above comes from the tombstone, not from strictness.
  - `DashboardComponentSchema`, `safeValidateSchema` (tolerant face) and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` (strict face) each parse the control and refuse `aria`. The tombstone appears at `chartConfig.aria` inside the widget slot's spec-widget union arm.
  - A spec-standing case: the spec's own `DashboardWidgetChartConfigSchema` still refuses `aria`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/4044-chartconfig-aria-tombstone.md`: `@object-ui/types` **minor**. A published face (TypeScript) that accepted `aria` now refuses it. This is the same grading the objectui#9736 and objectui#9409 changesets gave when a key moved from a parse-time refusal to a compile-time one.

## Zone 2 measurements (dispatch order)

1. **Where the twin comes from.** Zod `DashboardWidgetSchema` takes the spec by reference, so it inherits the tombstone. TypeScript `DashboardWidgetSchema` re-typed `chartConfig` as `any`, so it accepted `aria`. The `reports` faces are not on this path: `ReportSectionSchema.chart` is objectui's own SDUI `ChartSchema`, not the spec's chart config. `DashboardWidgetConfigSchema` / `DashboardWidgetConfig` (the config-panel model) has `chartConfig: z.any()`, see Acceptance notes.
2. **Reproduce first, at `origin/main` `1ccb5ba7de`, with the built dist.** All four Zod faces already refused `{ title, aria }`, so the work was the pin plus the TypeScript member. ⚠️ The dispatch probe `{ type: 'bar', aria }` and its control `{ type: 'bar', title }` do not fit this face. The spec retired `chartConfig.type` on a dashboard widget in the same 17.5.0 release (the widget's own `type` is the chart family), so on every dashboard face the control is refused at `chartConfig.type`. The triage probe parsed the react-tier `ChartConfigSchema`, where `type` is required, not `DashboardWidgetChartConfigSchema`. The pin uses `{ title }` as its control.
3. **TypeScript twin.** `chartConfig` was `any`, not an index-signature fall-through. It is fixed as described above.
4. **Readers.** I found no live `chartConfig.aria` read in `plugin-charts`, `plugin-dashboard`, `core`'s `chart-presentation` or `plugin-report`. The only hits are comments and the existing negative pins ("ignores chartConfig.aria"). Those pins hand `aria` straight to the renderer, so they stay valid and pass unchanged. Nothing was removed and no reader was added (ruling B was not taken).
5. **Docs.** No `content/docs/**`, README or SKILL file authors `chartConfig.aria`, so there was nothing to correct. Control: the same grep finds `chartConfig` in `plugin-charts.mdx` and the dashboard-level `aria` note in `plugin-dashboard.mdx`.

## Verification (at head `8c74849360`)

- Builds and type-checks: `pnpm turbo run type-check --concurrency=2` over `@object-ui/types`, `core`, `sdui-parser`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-designer`, `app-shell` and `example-schema-catalog` reads `Tasks: 42 successful, 42 total`. That list is every package importing `DashboardWidgetSchema` / `DashboardComponentSchema`, plus `plugin-charts`. Each package's `type-check` also compiles its test files.
- Tests: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` plus the 28 suites outside `packages/types` that mention `chartConfig` / `ChartConfigSchema` read `Test Files 330 passed (330)`, `Tests 7957 passed (7957)`.
- Gates: `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only, exit 0); `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`); `check:control-bytes` OK; `check:spec-symbols` OK; `check:changeset-claims` OK; `check:pending-changeset-literals` OK; `check:test-path-roots` OK; `check:installed-pin-claims` OK; `check:shell-escape-residue` OK; `changeset:check` OK; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` reads `2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
- Lint, narrowed to the two changed TypeScript files with the root config, `eslint --no-inline-config --format json`: 2 files, 0 errors. `complex.ts` has 9 `no-explicit-any` warnings, the same 9 its base blob has. The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move another file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` run belongs to CI.

### Ablations (committed first, mutated with `ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

- **TypeScript member reverted to `chartConfig?: any`** (anchor 1 to 0): `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exits 2. It reports TS2322 on `ariaDeclared` and on `ariaNotAny`, and TS2578 for the unused `@ts-expect-error`. The `IsAny` guard is needed: under `any`, the bare "admits no value" check stays green.
- **Zod twin given its own `chartConfig: z.any().optional()`** (the shape the TypeScript twin had): the pin reads `Tests 5 failed | 4 passed (9)`. The twin refusal, the strictness contrast and all three dashboard faces go red. The spec-standing case and the parse controls stay green.

## Acceptance notes

- **TypeScript and Zod still disagree on the other chart-config keys.** The TypeScript face still accepts any other chart-config key, while the Zod twin (and the spec) refuse `type` / `xAxis` / `yAxis` / `series` on a dashboard widget and refuse unknown keys. Typing the whole member by reference would close that gap, but it would change the TypeScript verdict on keys this dispatch fenced off. It is reported to the seat, not done here.
- **Config-panel model.** `DashboardWidgetConfigSchema.chartConfig` is `z.any()`, so it admits `aria` (and every other retired chart key). `DashboardConfigPanel` / `DashboardWithConfig` never write `chartConfig` (0 hits; control: `widgets` is found), so nothing produces it on that model. Nothing was filed. Carrier: none.
- **Stale comments.** Comments in `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts` and in the existing negative pins in `plugin-dashboard` / `plugin-charts` still call `aria` "declared by ChartConfigSchema" or "pending objectstack#5175". Since 17.5.0 it is a tombstone. These files are outside this card's file surface and were left alone. Carrier: none.
- **Same-day churn.** PR objectui#11303 and PR objectui#11301 landed on `main` after the branch point. Neither touches this diff's files, `chartConfig` or `DashboardWidgetSchema`, so no merge was needed.

Dev session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ` (dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM loop).
